clue.text: A supporter isn't prepared to accept the pennies left

indicators.note: to accept means to take in, so the shuffled letters hold the other pieces inside
prepared in the sense of worked up or dressed, so the letters of the word before it are rearranged

parts.note: the letters I, S, N, T, the apostrophe ignored
P is the abbreviation for pence or pennies

explanation.surface: Someone backing a cause refuses to take the small change remaining.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prepared' rearranges ISNT into S...INT, and 'accept' puts P and L inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A splint is a rigid strip that supports and holds a broken limb in place.

clue.text: A French guy having a way with him may be ignored

parts.note: un is the French for a
a guy is a man, a fellow, referred to as he
RD is the abbreviation for road, a way

explanation.surface: A Frenchman who has a knack about him could be overlooked.
explanation.walkthrough: Pieces run in order: UN, HE, A, RD.
explanation.definitionFit: Something not listened to or unheeded is in effect disregarded, as a plea may be.

clue.text: Dunderhead joining a union and hanging around

parts.note: the head of Dunder, its first letter, is D
an alliance is a union of parties

explanation.surface: A dimwit signs up to a union and then just loiters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dunderhead' is read as Dunder's head, its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Dalliance is idle lingering or trifling, time spent loitering.

clue.text: Stronger liquor that adds pungency to duck

parts.note: a sting is a sharp, biting quality, a pungency
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, so O

explanation.surface: A strong drink that gives some bite to a dish of duck.
explanation.walkthrough: A duck in cricket is a score of zero, so it gives O.
explanation.definitionFit: Stingo is an old name for strong ale or beer.

clue.text: New variety of lemons-quite weighty

indicators.note: a new variety is a fresh arrangement, so the letters of the fruit word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fresh kind of citrus fruit turns out rather heavy.
explanation.definitionFit: Solemn means grave or serious, carrying weight in manner.

clue.text: Remains in pain, so hiding away

indicators.note: in places the remains piece within the pain piece

parts.note: a sting is a sharp pain
ash is what remains after burning

explanation.surface: Someone stays hurt and so withdraws from view.
explanation.definitionFit: Stashing is putting things away in a secret store, concealing them.

clue.text: The Chancellor naturally includes the woman

indicators.note: includes means the run of letters sits inside the two words that follow it

explanation.surface: The Chancellor of course has a female figure in his circle.
explanation.walkthrough: The run spans the end of Chancellor and the start of naturally.
explanation.definitionFit: Lorna is a girl's name, so it stands for a female person.

clue.text: Obscure about agreement not properly laid out

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the obscuring word wraps round the agreement word

parts.note: to mist is to blur or obscure
a deal is an agreement

explanation.surface: A dim cloud hangs over a contract that was badly arranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Misdealt describes cards dealt wrongly, distributed out of order.

clue.text: Friend accompanying compulsive workers flags

parts.note: a Friend is a Quaker, and William Penn was a famous one
ants are proverbially tireless workers

explanation.surface: A companion goes along with workaholics carrying banners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Friend' with a capital is a Quaker; William Penn founded Pennsylvania.
explanation.definitionFit: Pennants are long tapering flags flown on ships or at sports grounds.

clue.text: Body of sportsmen coming from Ireland-not too bad

parts.note: the FA is the Football Association, English football's governing body
Irish means from Ireland

explanation.surface: A sports team from Ireland gave a passable showing.
explanation.walkthrough: The FA, the Football Association, runs English football.
explanation.definitionFit: Fairish means moderately good, reasonably acceptable.

clue.text: Thought a trainee most desirable

parts.note: an idea is a thought
L stands for learner, as on a learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: Someone reckoned a beginner was the best pick.
explanation.walkthrough: L is a learner: British learner drivers display L-plates.
explanation.definitionFit: Ideal means perfect, the best one could wish for.

clue.text: Cut by the diner when it's warmer

parts.note: a gash is a deep cut
a diner is an eater

explanation.surface: Someone eating is wounded at a moment when the weather is milder.
explanation.definitionFit: A gas heater is an appliance burning fuel to warm a room.

clue.text: A member of a military force

definitions.meaning: a member is a limb of the body
a branch of the services, like the Fleet Air one

explanation.definitionFit: An arm is a limb of the body, and also a branch of the armed services such as the air arm.

clue.text: A fighter made to study the alternative

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it at university
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A soldier was forced to do his reading or else.
explanation.definitionFit: A toreador is a bullfighter, especially one on horseback.

clue.text: Clear of all charges, let involvement cause irritation

parts.note: net means after all deductions are taken off

indicators.note: involvement suggests letters entangled and mixed up together

explanation.surface: Once free of all fees, letting a property can still prove annoying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involvement' shuffles LET into TLE after NET.
explanation.definitionFit: To nettle someone is to annoy or provoke them.

clue.text: Nearly set wrong in a serious way

indicators.note: wrong means the letters of the two words before it are put in a faulty order

explanation.surface: Something almost set has gone badly awry.
explanation.definitionFit: Earnestly means with sincere and intense conviction, gravely.

clue.text: Prospect for gold in Central America

indicators.note: in places the gold piece within the country

parts.note: Panama is a country in Central America
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: Someone goes looking for gold in Central America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prospect for gold' looks like the definition, but only 'Prospect' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A panorama is a wide view or vista, a prospect of the landscape.

clue.text: Many given lines shed tears

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, many
RY is short for railway, a set of lines

explanation.surface: Lots of people given lines to learn break down weeping.
explanation.definitionFit: To cry is to weep.

clue.text: Beasts responsible for the present transport system

definitions.text: Beasts responsible for the present transport system

parts.words: Beasts responsible for the present transport system
parts.note: the animals who pull Father Christmas's sleigh and so carry the presents

explanation.surface: Animals that run today's public transport network.
explanation.walkthrough: 'present' means a gift, not now: Santa's sleigh team.
explanation.definitionFit: These antlered deer pull Santa's sleigh of gifts in folklore.

clue.text: A Turkish officer appearing in drag amused everyone

indicators.note: appearing in means the run of letters shows up within the following words

explanation.surface: An Ottoman officer turning up in women's clothes delighted all.
explanation.definitionFit: An aga was a military commander or chief in the Ottoman Empire.

clue.text: Hand born a Red Indian

parts.note: a paw is a jocular word for a hand
née means born, used of a maiden name

explanation.surface: A hand was born a Native American.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pawnee are a Native American people of the Great Plains.

clue.text: One may be taken over the church-it's very cold

indicators.note: in a down clue, putting one piece over another sets it first

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: One may be carried over the church on a freezing day.
explanation.definitionFit: Ice is frozen water, very cold indeed.

clue.text: Bill's story

definitions.meaning: a bill is a statement of money owed
a story is a narrative or report

explanation.definitionFit: An account is both a bill of charges and a narrative report of events.

clue.text: Showing scorn maybe about 21 down being used for decoration

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the shuffled letters go round the other answer
maybe suggests the letters could be arranged otherwise

parts.note: the answer to 21 down is ice

explanation.surface: Disdain perhaps surrounds frozen sculpture used as ornament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' rearranges SCORN to CORNS, split round ICE.
explanation.definitionFit: Cornices are ornamental mouldings along the top of walls, a form of architectural ornament.

clue.text: Spoke and read to reformed characters

indicators.note: reformed means shaped anew, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone spoke and read aloud to inmates who had mended their ways.
explanation.definitionFit: Orated means made a formal speech, declaimed.

clue.text: Writing up listeners' aspersions

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: MS is a manuscript, a piece of writing
ears are listeners

explanation.surface: Writing up the slanders that eavesdroppers heard.
explanation.definitionFit: Smears are slanderous attacks on a reputation.

clue.text: Competitor not in favour of a certain proposal

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
a tender is a formal offer or proposal

explanation.surface: A rival opposes a particular scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: A contender is a rival in a contest.

clue.text: The abstemious man imbibing little will be sound as a bird

indicators.note: imbibing means drinking in, so one piece is taken inside the other

parts.note: TT means teetotal, someone abstaining from alcohol
wee is Scots for little

explanation.surface: A teetotaller who has a tiny drink will still be in good health.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like healthy but is a noise.
explanation.definitionFit: A tweet is the chirp a small bird makes.

clue.text: Waterside buttress

definitions.meaning: the land along the edge of a sea or lake

explanation.definitionFit: A shore is the land at the edge of water; to shore up is to prop a structure with supports.

clue.text: Skipped-was concerned about exercise

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the concern word goes round the exercise word

parts.note: cared means was concerned
PE is physical education

explanation.surface: Someone missed a session, worried about the workout.
explanation.definitionFit: Capered means leapt about playfully, frisked and bounded.

clue.text: Capital fellow, the German!

definitions.meaning: a man from Germany's capital city
a German, as in Kennedy's famous declaration

explanation.definitionFit: A Berliner is a native of Berlin, the German capital, hence a German too.

clue.text: The leader having some aspiration to make changes

parts.note: an aspirate is the sound H, a breath
to alter is to make changes

explanation.surface: The boss has some ambition to bring about reform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'aspiration' is breathing, the H sound, not ambition; a halter leads a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A halter is a rope or strap by which a horse is led.
